# MoneroPriceNow

> MoneroPriceNow shows the live Monero (XMR) price with the real buy and sell prices aggregated across exchanges — not just a single mid-market number. It covers XMR priced in USD, Bitcoin, and Ethereum, with interactive charts, price history, and on-chain network fees.

MoneroPriceNow is a free, privacy-respecting, open-source Monero price tracker and part of the Monerica project. No account is required and there is no visitor tracking; the only ads are clearly-labeled sponsors.

## Price pages
- [Monero (XMR) price in USD](https://moneropricenow.com/): Live XMR/USD price, 24-hour change, interactive chart, all-time high, price history, and real exchange buy/sell prices.
- [Monero to Bitcoin (XMR/BTC)](https://moneropricenow.com/xmr-btc): Live Monero price denominated in Bitcoin, with chart and history.
- [Monero to Ethereum (XMR/ETH)](https://moneropricenow.com/xmr-eth): Live Monero price denominated in Ethereum, with chart and history.

## Network & data
- [Network fees](https://moneropricenow.com/network): Current on-chain transaction fees for Monero, Bitcoin, and Ethereum.
- Price API: https://moneropricenow.com/api/prices — JSON endpoint for live cross-exchange prices.
